items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: I think he went back to Old Man DeParis, Sidney's dad

ctx.x: All the other four had been in it.

Yeah, we went over there. So Herbert, he and Mr. Young got into some kind of disagreement about something, and he quit, he left, and he went somewhere... I don't know where, but I think he went back to Old Man DeParis, Sidney's dad -- I think he went on that show.

But anyway, we went up to this little show that Mr. Young had up there in Illinois. What we called a Gilley Show. That's one of them shows... It's a small show that travels... It don't travel with Pullman cars and wagons... Like a circus. You've seen a circus, how they travel. Well, that's the way that carnival traveled.
